title: Door-opening welcome features
summary: Feedback on door-opening behavior centers on appreciated welcome cues and easy door access, alongside a complaint about the vehicle powering off when the driver door opens, while many fragments are too brief or preference-only to fix sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the soft welcome sound when opening the door and the convenience of opening doors with a button.

negative.summary: Negative feedback objects to the vehicle powering off when the driver door is opened.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention door opening, welcome lighting, logo projection, or radio behavior on door open, but the examples are too brief or ambiguous to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confidence in a clearer sentiment pattern.
Several undetermined examples are very brief or describe desired changes rather than clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.
The topic mixes door-opening mechanics, welcome lighting, projected logos, and door-triggered audio behavior rather than one single feature.
